bagPolicy.summary: Only nonclear clutches or belt bags up to 6 × 9 inches and clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed; backpacks and totes are barred.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There is no general public parking on site on concert nights; advance-purchased accessible parking is the on-site exception.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the rideshare area a short walk east of the main gates. Follow the pedestrian walkways to reach it.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue is cashless and doesn't accept cash anywhere. You can bring one sealed water bottle or an empty reusable bottle (no glass) and fill it at the free water refill station. Some shows don't allow metal bottles, so check your pre-event email.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available at the back of listed 300 and 400 sections, with an accessible entrance near the box office. Arrange wheelchair escort or parking with the accessibility coordinator.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry into the venue is not permitted.

ticketPickup.summary: Concert entry is mobile only: save the mobile ticket to your wallet before reaching the gates; print-at-home tickets are unavailable.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Present a mobile ticket and allow time for security screening and bag searches at the main gates.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
